verdict.rationale: Apple publishes some concrete figures: up to 64GB unified memory and 273GB/s bandwidth, Thunderbolt 5 at 120Gb/s, and specific external-display limits. But much of the AI and performance messaging relies on adjectives ("blazing speed", "stunning imagery") and unqualified relative claims ("up to 2.1x faster than the latest AI PC chip"). Community commenters also question the choice of comparison baselines. Missing for 10: published CPU/GPU clock speeds, power/TDP figures, Neural Engine TOPS, test conditions behind the comparative performance and battery claims, and independent verification of the spec sheet.
